description: Enhanced token lifecycle edge cases covering combined login settings, revocation boundaries, header parsing, expiry refresh boundaries, cleanup counts, session limits, and prefix validation.

cases.description: Login combines a short custom session lifetime with profile output and a non-midnight frozen timestamp.
cases.expected_output:
route=/api/login/
login.status=200
login.url=/api/login/
login.expiry="2020-06-16T13:04:56Z"
login.token_present=true
login.token_prefix=
login.token_length=64
login.user_fields=username
login.user.username=john.doe
token_count=1
stored_token_keys_present=true

cases.description: Single-session logout with exactly one token revokes the only persisted session.
cases.expected_output:
route=/api/logout/
logout.status=204
logout.url=/api/logout/
logout.body=null
before.total_tokens=1
after.total_tokens=0

cases.description: All-sessions logout for one account preserves a single unrelated account token at the lower boundary.
cases.expected_output:
route=/api/logoutall/
logout.status=204
logout.url=/api/logoutall/
logout.body=null
before.user_tokens=1
before.other_user_tokens=1
after.user_tokens=0
after.other_user_tokens=1
after.total_tokens=1

cases.description: A default-protected request rejects a wrong authorization scheme before accepting the same token with the default scheme.
cases.expected_output:
request1.status=401
request1.url=/api/
request1.detail=Authentication credentials were not provided.
request2.status=200
request2.url=/api/
request2.body=User is authenticated.

cases.description: A non-configured authorization scheme with credentials is ignored rather than token-validated.
An authorization header containing only the scheme and trailing whitespace is still rejected as missing credentials.
An arbitrary sufficiently long but unknown token is rejected through the protected endpoint.
Expired cleanup through the protected API removes multiple expired sessions without observing the signal.
cases.expected_output:
route=/api/
request.status=401
request.url=/api/
request.detail=Invalid token.
tokens_before=3
tokens_after=0

cases.description: Automatic refresh at the minimum interval boundary still avoids rewriting expiry, and a later post-expiry check rejects the token.
cases.expected_output:
check1.status=200
check1.url=/api/
check1.body=User is authenticated.
check1.stored_expiry=2018-07-25T10:00:00
check2.status=401
check2.url=/api/
check2.detail=Invalid token.
check2.stored_expiry=null
original_expiry=2018-07-25T10:00:00

cases.description: A session limit of one can be filled by a first login despite expired tokens, then rejects the next login.
cases.expected_output:
login1.status=200
login1.url=/api/login/
login1.expiry="2020-01-01T10:00:00Z"
login1.token_present=true
login1.token_prefix=
login1.token_length=64
login2.status=403
login2.url=/api/login/
login2.error=Maximum amount of tokens allowed per user exceeded.
valid_tokens_after=1
total_tokens_after=3

cases.description: A token prefix at the maximum supported length is accepted by configuration validation.
